platforms.name: Gregale
strengths_outside_matrix: One-command backend PaaS with ~1s pause billing
Firecracker microVM isolation per app
Per-PR preview environments on Free
limitations: No persistent local disks or GPUs

non_interactive_json_cli.evidence: `gregale --non-interactive --json` never prompts and returns structured JSON error codes on stderr.

official_mcp_server.evidence: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server at api.gregale.dev/mcp with OAuth and /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json.

scoped_agent_identity.evidence: `gregale key create --agent` creates a dedicated agent identity separate from human logins, enforced server-side.

pre_mutation_cost_preview.evidence: `gregale scale --plan`, `gregale_plan_scale`, and `Gregale-Agent-Preview: budget` preview price deltas and budget remaining.

human_approval_gate_on_mutations.evidence: Agent-triggered production creates, deletes, and overrides pause and emit a human approval review link.

non_code_mutation_undo.evidence: `gregale mcp connection undo` reverts scaling, env vars, crons and domains logged across a 7-day activity window.

default_canary_auto_rollback.evidence: Production releases climb 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% by default and roll back automatically on 5xx errors (beta).

code_plus_postgres_rollback.evidence: `gregale rollback --restore-databases` restores managed Postgres to the release point-in-time alongside code (Hobby+).

platforms.name: Google Cloud Run
strengths_outside_matrix: Dozens of global GCP regions with Cloud Load Balancing
Generous monthly free tier (180k vCPU-s, 360k GiB-s, 2M requests)
Native VPC integration with BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and Cloud SQL
limitations: No bundled Postgres or built-in PR preview environments
Requires assembling Cloud Deploy, IAM, and Cloud SQL separately

non_interactive_json_cli.evidence: `gcloud run --quiet --format=json` executes non-interactively with structured JSON responses.

official_mcp_server.evidence: Google Cloud publishes an official Cloud Run MCP server for deploying and inspecting services.

scoped_agent_identity.evidence: Google Cloud IAM Service Accounts allow fine-grained least-privilege roles separate from personal user accounts.

pre_mutation_cost_preview.evidence: Deploy/scale commands do not return a pre-mutation monthly cost delta or agent budget check.

human_approval_gate_on_mutations.evidence: Available when explicitly configured via Google Cloud Deploy pipeline approval gates, not built into direct `gcloud run` deploys.

non_code_mutation_undo.evidence: Revisions cover container specs and traffic splits manually; there is no unified one-command agent mutation undo.

default_canary_auto_rollback.evidence: Manual traffic splitting is built in; automated canary stages and rollbacks require setting up Cloud Deploy.

code_plus_postgres_rollback.evidence: Cloud SQL is a separate product whose PITR restores independently of Cloud Run revisions.

platforms.name: Vercel
strengths_outside_matrix: Global edge CDN and Next.js / React Server Components integration
Instant PR preview URLs and collaborative frontend review toolbar
Fluid Compute pauses CPU during I/O waits
limitations: 300s/800s serverless function duration ceilings; third-party Postgres via Marketplace

non_interactive_json_cli.evidence: `vercel --yes --token` automates deploys, though JSON error/output schemas are not uniform across every subcommand.

official_mcp_server.evidence: Vercel hosts an official remote MCP server (`https://mcp.vercel.com`) with OAuth support.

scoped_agent_identity.evidence: Scoped personal/team access tokens exist without dedicated AI-agent policy roles or per-agent ceilings.

pre_mutation_cost_preview.evidence: Spend Management offers team-level alerts/auto-pause on Pro rather than per-command agent cost previews.

human_approval_gate_on_mutations.evidence: Deployment Protection and manual promotion controls exist on paid plans rather than out-of-band agent mutation approvals.

non_code_mutation_undo.evidence: Instant Rollback reverts deployments; environment variable edits require separate manual updates.

default_canary_auto_rollback.evidence: Rolling Releases on Pro/Enterprise allow gradual rollouts; automatic 5xx rollback is not enabled by default on all tiers.

code_plus_postgres_rollback.evidence: Databases are third-party Vercel Marketplace integrations managed independently of deployment rollbacks.

platforms.name: Northflank
strengths_outside_matrix: Bring-Your-Own-Cloud (BYOC) on AWS EKS, GCP GKE, and Azure AKS
Always-on Free Sandbox (2 services, 2 jobs, 1 database)
Enterprise RBAC, SOC 2, and GPU workloads
limitations: Kubernetes-oriented concepts add configuration overhead for small teams

non_interactive_json_cli.evidence: `northflank` CLI supports non-interactive execution and `--output json`.

official_mcp_server.evidence: No official first-party hosted Northflank MCP server documented.

scoped_agent_identity.evidence: Role-based team access and API tokens can scope permissions, without dedicated agent-policy budget semantics.

pre_mutation_cost_preview.evidence: Usage is metered per second ($0.01667/vCPU-h, $0.00833/GB-h) without pre-mutation CLI agent budget previews.

human_approval_gate_on_mutations.evidence: Release pipelines support configured approval steps, rather than automatic approval links on agent API mutations.

non_code_mutation_undo.evidence: No built-in one-command undo for arbitrary agent settings/env mutations across a workspace.

default_canary_auto_rollback.evidence: Supports configurable canary/blue-green traffic splitting, not an automatic 1%->100% 5xx rollback on every deploy by default.

code_plus_postgres_rollback.evidence: Service rollbacks and database addon backups restore independently.

platforms.name: Render
strengths_outside_matrix: Mature fixed-price PaaS and managed PostgreSQL from $6/mo
Flat predictable monthly instance pricing with unlimited free workspace collaborators on Hobby
Zero-downtime rolling deploys and `preDeployCommand` migrations
limitations: Paid web instances bill 24/7 even when idle
Free web services spin down after 15m and take ~1m to wake

non_interactive_json_cli.evidence: Render CLI supports `--output json` in non-interactive mode across core commands.

official_mcp_server.evidence: Render publishes an official MCP server (`https://mcp.render.com/mcp`) for inspecting services, logs, and databases.

scoped_agent_identity.evidence: Account and workspace API keys authenticate automation without separate AI-agent identity ceilings.

pre_mutation_cost_preview.evidence: Does not return a pre-mutation cost preview and remaining agent budget before applying scale updates.

human_approval_gate_on_mutations.evidence: No built-in out-of-band human approval link enforced on agent API mutations.

non_code_mutation_undo.evidence: Environment variable and instance plan edits must be reverted individually or via Blueprint commits.

default_canary_auto_rollback.evidence: Switches 100% of traffic once a deploy passes its health check; rollbacks are manual.

code_plus_postgres_rollback.evidence: Supports code rollbacks and paid Postgres PITR forks separately, without single-command coordinated rollback.

platforms.name: Railway
strengths_outside_matrix: One-click Postgres, Redis, MySQL, and MongoDB on a visual project canvas
Flexible pure usage metering beyond $5/mo Hobby credits
Fast builds and per-PR preview environments on paid workspaces
limitations: Serverless mode sleeps only after ~5-10 min without outbound packets
No progressive canary rollback on 5xx errors

non_interactive_json_cli.evidence: Railway CLI supports tokens and JSON flags on select inspect/status commands.

official_mcp_server.evidence: Railway publishes an official local MCP server package wrapping the authenticated Railway CLI.

scoped_agent_identity.evidence: Project-scoped tokens restrict scope to a single project/environment without dedicated agent approval policies.

pre_mutation_cost_preview.evidence: Workspace usage limits exist globally, without per-command cost previews before agent scaling.

human_approval_gate_on_mutations.evidence: No built-in human approval review gate for CLI or MCP mutations.

non_code_mutation_undo.evidence: Variable and scaling edits are re-applied individually; deployment rollback reverts releases only.

default_canary_auto_rollback.evidence: Replaces active deployment once health check passes; rollbacks are triggered manually.

code_plus_postgres_rollback.evidence: Deployment rollbacks and Postgres volume backups restore independently.

platforms.name: Fly.io
strengths_outside_matrix: Dozens of regions worldwide with low-latency edge placement
Firecracker microVMs (Machines) with regional NVMe volumes
Lower raw memory price ($2.19/mo 256 MB) for always-on servers
limitations: More manual infrastructure configuration in fly.toml and Machines API
Stopped Machines continue billing rootfs storage

non_interactive_json_cli.evidence: `flyctl --json` and the Machines REST API provide deterministic machine-readable output.

official_mcp_server.evidence: No official first-party Fly.io MCP server published.

scoped_agent_identity.evidence: Org and per-app deploy tokens exist without dedicated AI-agent approval/budget primitives.

pre_mutation_cost_preview.evidence: Machine resize/create APIs apply immediately without returning monthly cost impact or budget checks.

human_approval_gate_on_mutations.evidence: No built-in human approval review pause on `flyctl` or Machines API mutations.

non_code_mutation_undo.evidence: Machine config and secrets changes must be undone manually via CLI/API calls.

default_canary_auto_rollback.evidence: Rolling deploy default; canary strategy health-checks one new Machine first without a 1%->100% 5xx traffic ladder.

code_plus_postgres_rollback.evidence: Supports image rollbacks and Managed Postgres snapshot restores separately, requiring manual coordination.

platforms.name: Koyeb
strengths_outside_matrix: Firecracker microVMs across multiple global edge regions plus serverless GPUs
Light Sleep scale-to-zero wakes rapidly (~250 ms)
Low entry Eco instances ($1.61/mo nano) with no base seat fee on Hobby
limitations: Free Postgres sleeps after 5m and caps at 50h/mo; paid Postgres starts at $29.76/mo

non_interactive_json_cli.evidence: `koyeb` CLI supports non-interactive authentication via token and `--output json`.

official_mcp_server.evidence: No official first-party Koyeb MCP server documented.

scoped_agent_identity.evidence: User and organization API tokens exist without dedicated agent approval/budget policies.

pre_mutation_cost_preview.evidence: Service scaling calls do not return pre-flight agent budget/cost projections.

human_approval_gate_on_mutations.evidence: No built-in approval gate halting agent mutations for out-of-band human sign-off.

non_code_mutation_undo.evidence: Immutable deployment versions support manual rollback; there is no unified one-command agent mutation undo.

default_canary_auto_rollback.evidence: Deploys shift after health checks; no default 1%->100% automatic 5xx rollback ladder.

code_plus_postgres_rollback.evidence: Application deployment rollbacks and PostgreSQL instances are managed separately.
